light_description: Marshall-style medium/high-gain drive with broad gain range and TIGHT/DEEP voicing; official SHINOS catalog documents the original lineage and a 2023 compact-body renewal.
Transparent-style natural overdrive with substantial gain, TIGHT/DEEP switch and strong emphasis on preserving guitar/amp character.
British-style medium/high-gain drive extending the Blue Tongue series with natural drive through deep distortion and highly responsive feel.
SUMO STOMP reproduction of Klon Centaur serial #873, documented by the builder as a close clone with matched tone, gain and buffer behavior.
SUMO STOMP reproduction of a Klon Centaur Short Tail #S430, documented as a close clone of its tone and gain behavior.
Bass-focused descendant of Longtail #873, using the Centaur #873 reference as its starting point and tuning the response for bass.
High-accuracy reproduction of a specific 1981 vintage TS808, serial 126700, documented as a vintage clone.
Reproduction of an early black-label TS-9, serial 165160, documented by SUMO STOMP as a vintage clone.
Texas-blues-oriented adaptation of the SUMO #8 concept, based on Tone of Gold's #1Limited specification and tuned within the SUMO STOMP format.
Compact reproduction of a 1972 Triangle Big Muff, documented by SUMO STOMP as a vintage clone using selected vintage-era parts.
